subject.title: Feature: Auto-leave WhatsApp groups not in allowlist + group-join webhook

question: What WhatsApp unauthorized-group membership behavior should OpenClaw support before exposing a destructive leave operation or group-join event?
rationale: The requested behavior is security-sensitive and user-visible: it changes bot group membership, may expose new privacy-bearing join events, and needs a deliberate split between group admission and sender authorization.

options.title: Implement opt-in WhatsApp auto-leave
options.body: Add an opt-in WhatsApp plugin feature driven by group admission misses, with account/target authorization, owner notification semantics, docs, tests, and live WhatsApp proof.

options.title: Fold into group pairing first
options.body: Keep this issue linked to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/11489 and define shared owner-notification semantics before adding WhatsApp-specific leave behavior.

options.title: Reject automated leave behavior
options.body: Keep the current drop/warn behavior and document manual cleanup if maintainers decide automated WhatsApp membership changes are too risky.

recommendation.title: Implement opt-in WhatsApp auto-leave
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in WhatsApp plugin feature driven by group admission misses, with account/target authorization, owner notification semantics, docs, tests, and live WhatsApp proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the visible prior reviewer on this issue and the most recent adjacent current-main WhatsApp config/runtime contributor in the local history.
